headlines.title: Louisiana warns against flesh-eating bacteria after five deaths
headlines.description: Louisiana health officials are urging residents to take precautions against a flesh-eating bacterial infection following the deaths of five people this year.

headlines.title: How 3 health factors can help delay dementia for up to 13 years
headlines.description: New research from NYU Langone Health found that people who avoid three vascular risk factors in middle age had about 13 more dementia-free years.

headlines.title: What watching sports does to your mind and body, according to scientists
headlines.description: Scientists find watching sports raises fans’ heart rates, spikes cortisol, and may even affect cardiovascular health – but researchers say the social benefits can outweigh the risks. From World Cup fever to the Knicks’ title run to a new NFL season, NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal looks at what cheering on your favorite team does to your body.

headlines.title: Need a Summer Wellness Reset? Ally Love Shares 4 Ways to Do It
headlines.description: August is National Wellness Month so if you’re in need of a reset, Ally Love has four pillars to help you do just that. She shares ways to move, nourish, rest and connect.

headlines.title: Are Budget Cuts Behind Recent Outbreaks in Foodborne Illnesses?
headlines.description: The CDC and the FDA are saying the tainted lettuce and jalapeños linked to contaminated food illnesses have been traced to Mexico where 63% of all vegetables imported to the United States are grown. Now, some experts are saying recent budget cuts by the Trump administration could have played a role in the outbreak of those illnesses. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Influencer Sydney Towle dies at 26 after documenting rare cancer illness
headlines.description: Sydney Towle, who shared her treatment for a rare form of cancer called Cholangiocarcinoma, has died. Towle used her social media to challenge assumptions about how people with serious illnesses live their lives. NBC News' Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Where to find NIOSH-approved N95 masks right now
headlines.description: NIOSH-approved N95 respirators are the most protective type of face mask, according to the CDC. Doctors explain how to shop for them.

headlines.title: The best dog food for growing puppies
headlines.description: Veterinarians share the best puppy food to support healthy growth and development. Shop options from trusted brands like Purina, Royal Canin and Hill’s.

headlines.title: Back-to-school shoe sale: Save up to 55% off Nike, Crocs, New Balance, Brooks and more
headlines.description: Shop back-to-school shoe deals up to 55% off top brands like Nike, New Balance, and Crocs. Find popular styles for kids and adults before prices go up.

headlines.title: How to clean stainless steel appliances in just 4 steps
headlines.description: I learned the best way to clean stainless steel appliances, including the expert-recommend tools to use, like microfiber cloths and stainless steel wipes.

headlines.title: Michigan says salad is safe again as state’s cyclosporiasis cases fall
headlines.description: The state health department said residents can resume buying bagged salads but should still avoid recalled lettuce.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños at Chipotle and Qdoba expands to 27 states
headlines.description: Chipotle and Qdoba say they have removed the jalapeños from their restaurants.
